pages.title: Req. 0447
pages.text: $(bold)ORSA PROCUREMENT REVIEW$()$(br)Helion Confinement Test Facility$(br)From: Supervisor, Plasma Diagnostics$(br)Re: Req. 0447, six LC-4 emitters, field conversion for cutting$(br2)Third submission. The technician on second shift has filed it again.

The form is in order. The description is not. Where it asks for the item, the technician has once more written $(italic)hellwhip$() instead of the catalogue name.$(br2)Asked to correct it, they said the name comes from an old book they are reading, and that it suits the tool better than the catalogue does.

pages.title: Disposition
pages.text: $(italic)DENIED.$()$(br2)Resubmit under the catalogue name. ORSA does not requisition equipment by its nickname, and the board will not sign for a whip.$(br2)Note for the file: these are diagnostic emitters. Stop cutting the ice with them.
